units.source_text: 自此以后，源氏公子不断派人前来殷勤慰问。

en.t: From then on, Prince Genji repeatedly sent people to ask after her with attentive concern.

units.source_text: 不料别后七八日，六条妃子就逝世了。

en.t: Unexpectedly, seven or eight days after they parted, the Rokujo lady passed away.

units.source_text: 源氏公子遭此意外之变，痛感人世无常，顿觉心灰意懒。

en.t: Struck by this unforeseen loss, Prince Genji felt keenly the impermanence of human life and suddenly lost all heart.

units.source_text: 他也不去上朝，专心安排葬仪与佛事。

en.t: He stopped going to court and devoted himself to arranging the funeral rites and Buddhist services.

units.source_text: 六条宫邸方面并无特别可信赖之人。

en.t: At the Rokujo residence, there was no one especially reliable to depend on.

units.source_text: 只有前斋宫的几个年老的旧宫官，勉勉强强地料理着事务。

en.t: Only a few elderly former palace officials who had served the former Kamo priestess were managing the affairs as best they could.

units.source_text: 源氏公子亲自来到六条宫邸，向前斋宫吊慰。

en.t: Prince Genji came in person to the Rokujo residence to offer condolences and comfort to the former priestess.

units.source_text: 前斋宫命侍女长代致答辞：“惨遭大故，方寸迷乱，不知所答了！”

en.t: The former priestess had the chief lady-in-waiting reply on her behalf: "Overwhelmed by this terrible bereavement, my heart is in confusion, and I do not know how to answer."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“我对太夫人曾有诺言，太夫人对我亦有遗命。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "I once made a promise to the lady, and she too left me her final wishes.

units.source_text: 今后倘蒙开诚相待，委以万事，则幸甚矣。”

en.t: If from now on you would be so kind as to treat me with openness and entrust all matters to me, I would be most grateful."

units.source_text: 他就召集邸内所有人员，吩咐一切应有事宜。

en.t: He then gathered everyone in the residence and gave instructions for everything that needed to be done.

units.source_text: 用心之忠诚周到，足以抵偿近年来疏阔之罪了。

en.t: His loyal and meticulous care was enough to make amends for the neglect and distance of recent years.

units.source_text: 六条妃子的葬仪备极隆重，二条院内所有人员，悉数前来服役。

en.t: The funeral rites for the Rokujo lady were conducted with the utmost solemnity, and everyone from the Nijo estate came to assist.
